$description: Generated by scripts/build_scale_tokens.py from the iOS export (TroncKit f79fe3339, shadow group). No shared elevation scale exists in the code; each shadow is set where it is used. Checked against f79fe3339. CSS blur is 2 x the iOS shadowRadius (the same conversion Figma uses). Recirculation cards take their shadow from the article style; if unset: opacity 1, radius 1, offset 0,2 (RecirculationItemCell.swift:97). Do not edit by hand.
